mapper.select: SELECT p.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.stlm_mthd_cd,p.use_yn FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT p.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.stlm_mthd_cd,p.use_yn FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.bill_stg_id,s.prj_id,s.stg_odr_no,s.sply_amt,s.bill_plan_dt FROM prj.bill_stg s WHERE s.prj_id=#{projectId} AND s.bill_stg_id=#{stageId}

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,COALESCE(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) AS cntrct_dev_id, d.dev_nm AS display_name,a.asgn_se_cd,m.mm_qty,u.bill_untprc_amt AS untprc_amt, t.atnd_id,t.work_day_qty,t.rglr_tm_qty,COALESCE(t.ovtm_tm_qty,0) AS ovtm_tm_qty,t.mth_work_day_qty FROM asgn.asgn a LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= GREATEST(CAST(#{month} || '-01' AS date),a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1 ) u ON true LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=COALESCE(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < (CAST(#{month} || '-01' AS date)+INTERVAL '1 month') AND a.end_dt >= CAST(#{month} || '-01' AS date) ORDER BY a.asgn_id
SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT o.num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std o WHERE o.oprt_std_id='VAT_RATE' AND o.aply_bgn_ym <=#{month} ORDER BY o.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{prefix},0))::text
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(b.bill_no FROM LENGTH(#{prefix})+1) AS integer)),0)+1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%' AND b.bill_no ~ '^B-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+$'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=#{projectId} AND b.bill_stg_id=#{stageId} AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL' AND b.orgnl_bill_id IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(b.bill_odr_no),0) FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=#{projectId} AND b.atrb_ym=#{month} AND b.orgnl_bill_id IS NULL AND b.bill_stts_cd IN ('DRAFT','CONFIRM')
FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: WITH raw AS ( SELECT b.bill_id,b.bill_stg_id,false AS virtual_plan,b.bill_no,b.prj_id,b.atrb_ym,b.bill_dt, b.sply_amt,b.vat_amt,b.tot_amt,b.bill_stts_cd,b.txinv_no,b.txinv_dt,b.rcpt_plan_dt,b.orgnl_bill_id, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN TO_CHAR(COALESCE(b.bill_dt,s.bill_plan_dt,b.created_at::date),'YYYY-MM') ELSE b.atrb_ym END AS view_month FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN prj.bill_stg s ON s.bill_stg_id=b.bill_stg_id UNION ALL SELECT NULL::bigint,s.bill_stg_id,true,NULL::varchar,s.prj_id,TO_CHAR(s.bill_plan_dt,'YYYY-MM'), s.bill_plan_dt,s.sply_amt,0::bigint,s.sply_amt,'PLAN',NULL::varchar,NULL::date,NULL::date,NULL::bigint, TO_CHAR(s.bill_plan_dt,'YYYY-MM') FROM prj.bill_stg s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id AND p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_stg_id=s.bill_stg_id AND b.orgnl_bill_id IS NULL AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL') ), balances AS ( SELECT b.*,p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name, p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id),0)::bigint AS received_amt, (b.tot_amt+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0))::bigint AS adjusted_total_amt FROM raw b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id ), receivables AS ( SELECT b.*,CASE WHEN b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' THEN GREATEST(0,b.adjusted_total_amt-b.received_amt) ELSE 0 END::bigint AS receivable_amt FROM balances b ), billing_rows AS ( SELECT b.*,CASE WHEN b.receivable_amt=0 OR b.rcpt_plan_dt IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt >=60 THEN 3 WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt >=30 THEN 2 WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt >=7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reminder_stage FROM receivables b )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_rows b
SELECT b.* FROM billing_rows b ORDER BY b.${orderBy} ${direction} NULLS LAST,b.bill_id DESC NULLS LAST,b.bill_stg_id DESC
SELECT b.* FROM billing_rows b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
SELECT b.* FROM billing_rows b WHERE b.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY b.bill_id

SELECT d.asgn_id,a.dev_id,d.cntrct_dev_id,COALESCE(n.dev_nm,'청구 단계') AS display_name, d.work_ym,d.mm_qty,d.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,d.untprc_amt,d.work_day_qty,d.work_tm_qty, d.ovtm_tm_qty,d.ovtm_amt,d.bill_amt,d.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev n ON n.dev_id=d.cntrct_dev_id WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.bill_dtl_id
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_id

SELECT CONCAT(h.data_chg_ty_cd,' ',h.clmn_nm,': ',h.bfr_val,' → ',h.aft_val) AS description, h.chg_at AS changed_at,h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=CAST(#{id} AS text) ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC

INSERT INTO bill.bill(bill_no,prj_id,bill_stg_id,bill_odr_no,atrb_ym,bill_dt,sply_amt,vat_amt, bill_stts_cd,txinv_no,txinv_dt,rcpt_plan_dt,created_by) VALUES(#{number},#{identity.projectId},#{identity.stageId},#{identity.ordinal},#{identity.month}, #{fields.bill_dt},#{money.supply},#{money.vat},'DRAFT',#{fields.txinv_no},#{fields.txinv_dt}, #{fields.rcpt_plan_dt},#{actor}) RETURNING bill_id
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.bill SET atrb_ym=#{identity.month},bill_dt=#{fields.bill_dt},sply_amt=#{money.supply}, vat_amt=#{money.vat},txinv_no=#{fields.txinv_no},txinv_dt=#{fields.txinv_dt}, rcpt_plan_dt=#{fields.rcpt_plan_dt},rmrk_desc=#{fields.rmrk_desc},updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND bill_stts_cd='DRAFT'
UPDATE bill.bill_dtl SET work_ym=#{month} WHERE bill_id=#{id}
